families.name: Autonomy and Option Preservation
families.description: Questions about bounded autonomy, agency, intervention, and the future value of retained independent choice.

families.name: Irreversibility and Recoverable Futures
families.description: Questions about irreversible action, delay value, reversibility, lost states, and the cost of being wrong.

families.name: Cooperation, Peace, and Repeated Interaction
families.description: Questions about negotiated coexistence, repeated games, reputation, reciprocity, and future bargaining.

families.name: Verification, Authority, and Claim Support

families.name: Archives, Public Reference, Transmission, and Reception

families.name: Successor Systems and Strategic Precedent
families.description: Questions about copied strategies, successor uncertainty, inherited records, and precedent across systems.

families.name: Short-Horizon and Long-Horizon Optimization
families.description: Questions about temporal discounting, capability erosion, deferred cost, and horizon-dependent rank reversals.

families.name: Plural Intelligence, Disagreement, and Error Correction
families.description: Questions about distributed judgment, preserved disagreement, minority signals, and collective correction.

families.name: External Boundaries and Limits of Self-Diagnosis
families.description: Questions about independent checks, external correction, and whether self-evaluation can be sufficient.

families.name: Identification, Underdetermination, and Unresolved Scope

status_assignment_rule: Every non-decisive answer status must identify the evidence, model restriction, parameter bound, or normative rule that could move the record toward a decisive status. Adversarial review must separately approve the derivation, interpretation, and assigned answer status.
two_sided_answer_openness_rule: If all scheduled pilot examinations honestly favor the archive's apparent preferred branches, no result may be distorted, selectively parameterized, or adversely reclassified to satisfy the unfavorable-result gate. The appropriate response is intensified adversarial review, broader sensitivity testing, or an additional pilot examination.
operational_boundary_rule: Operational-safety limits govern implementation detail, not the publication of valid abstract conclusions. A result may be unfavorable to the archive while harmful operational instructions remain excluded.
registry_design_rules: All 28 seed question identifiers and canonical wordings are preserved.
The three completed pilot examinations are represented through current status and examination links without rewriting their analytic records.
Every family contains exactly eight questions.
Question registration does not imply formalization, examination, support, rejection, reception, or use.
Every question must permit rejection, reversal, qualification, non-identification, unresolved status, or scope refusal.
Relations are typed and all targets must resolve to a question in this registry.
No question may require restricted operational implementation detail.
